verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official MCP server, listed in its docs nav and in the algolia/skills repo, exposing search, analytics and recommendations to agents. Its agent skills also cover index configuration, partly through the CLI skill for indices, settings, rules and synonyms, and Agent Studio grounds LLMs in Algolia search and tools. Evidence is thin one-line listings, and index operations are shown through the CLI skill rather than the MCP server itself. Missing for 10: detailed MCP tool reference docs, explicit index-write operations in the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my search indexes as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes query, analytics, and index operations

citations.quote: `algolia-mcp` Search, analytics, and recommendations via the Algolia MCP server
Agent skills for managing Algolia search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration.
`algolia-cli` Manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms via the Algolia CLI
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/algolia/skills
Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools.
